column1: # Reviewer-runnable CUDA L2 crossover demonstration on 7,028 TCGA
# training representatives and all 3,013 held-back queries.
# This compact, deterministic setup tests the scoped observation that the
# hierarchy can improve the direct-scan latency/fidelity frontier at lower
# accuracy, while flat search takes over at higher accuracy. GEMM counterparts
# remain present to show that the observation is strategy-dependent.
# Flat follows T={1,2,4,8,16,32,48,64}. T=48 brackets the observed
# high-accuracy crossover between the powers-of-two controls.
# Hierarchy follows a predeclared staircase from low to high fidelity:
# All approximate runs use seed=42, one warmup, three timed trials, and B=128.
# The fixed seed makes this a reproducible demonstration, not a sampling-
# variance study. The ignored exploratory checkpoints contain the broader
# parameter search; they are not part of the public experiment catalog.
# The strategy covers both FP32 stages: direct JL plus direct scan, or SGEMM
# JL plus SGEMM scan. exact_cuda_direct is the FP32 device reference;
# exact_cuda_gemm remains a reported candidate so numerical selection
# differences stay visible. The exact runs use one trial to avoid spending
# several minutes repeatedly scanning the full 7,028 x 60,660 matrix.
